item.tib: sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa nges don rdzogs pa chen po kun bzang dgongs pa 'khor 'das zangs thal
item.coloph: bdag 'dra mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pas kong yul gyi gnas chen dbus phyogs yongs rdzong dpal gyi phug nas sa pho rta yi lor phag zla'i tshes bzang por rol mo'i rigs kyis bsus te spyan drangs nas slar gyim shod shel brag tshal du sa lug zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes la khyung nag dpal gyi rdzong du shog ser bod yig tu bsgyur ba'o//
